title: F_7 HIP device kernel
description:
Implement the F_7 HIP device kernel mirroring T23/T24, using the F_7 packed encoding chosen by R2.

## Background

Same shape as T23/T24. The F_7 mul-via-LUT (per R2's outcome) lives in `__constant__` device memory; the LUT initialiser is identical to the host-side static const.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/hip/permanent/permanent_bipedal7.hip` exists with the device kernel.
- [ ] [hard] On gfx1030, kernel output bit-identical to CPU `permanent_bipedal7` on 100 random matrices for $n \in \{8, 12\}$.
- [ ] [hard] LUT in `__constant__` memory is populated identically to the host static const (verified by a runtime checksum on the CPU/GPU pair).
- [ ] [hard] Tests gated `#[cfg(feature = \"hip\")]` and `#[ignore = \"external: gfx1030 device required\"]`.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo build --manifest-path crates/gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml --features hip --release` succeeds (the HIP crate is workspace-excluded; the `--manifest-path` invocation is the correct way to build it). **See Amendment 2026-05-15 (build-invocation).**

## Amendment 2026-05-15 (build-invocation) — criterion 5 wording

The original criterion 5 read `cargo build -p gf2-kernels-hip --release --features hip succeeds`. Because the `gf2-kernels-hip` crate is excluded from the workspace (root `Cargo.toml`), `cargo` rejects this invocation with `error: cannot specify features for packages outside of workspace`. The correct invocation is `cargo build --manifest-path crates/gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml --features hip --release`. The criterion now uses the correct invocation; intent is unchanged (HIP crate must build clean on a ROCm host with the `hip` feature).
